desc: Ideation: reduce problem to finding LCS of two required-operation sequences (red and blue), with answer = len(R)+len(B)-LCS(R,B).
Implement feasibility check: find P-cycle containing X and Q-cycle containing X; return -1 if any A_i=1 outside P-cycle or any B_i=1 outside Q-cycle.
Compute M_R = max distance along P to X over all i with A_i=1; compute M_B similarly along Q.
Build sequence R: start at X, repeatedly apply invP to get v_1, v_2, ..., v_{M_R}, then reverse to get farthest-to-nearest order. Build B analogously with invQ.
Compute LCS length of R and B in O(N log N): map each element of R to its index, filter B to those present, compute LIS of the resulting index list.
Output len(R)+len(B)-LCS (0 if both empty); ensure X itself is never operated and balls at X are ignored.
Test against all four samples and edge cases (no balls, fixed points, disconnected cycles) — all 4 samples passed.
